name: Sainath
eyebrow: Software Engineer · Applied AI & Java Backend
headline: Building intelligent backend systems with Java, Spring Boot, and modern AI platforms.
intro: Software engineer with 10+ years of experience designing production-grade Java services, distributed systems, and applied AI workflows. Experienced in turning complex business rules and operational processes into reliable, measurable software.

specialties.title: 🤖 Applied AI workflows
specialties.description: Turning business rules and operational decisions into reliable, reviewable AI-assisted workflows.

specialties.title: ⚙️ Java backend systems
specialties.description: Designing resilient services and event-driven architectures for complex, long-running processes.

specialties.title: 🧰 Engineering platforms
specialties.description: Building internal tools and data foundations that make teams faster and production operations clearer.

responsibilities: Engineered generative-AI claim-pend rule automation with Google ADK and Gemini to evaluate business rules, execute eligible workflows, and route exceptions for review.
Designed X12 835 Electronic Remittance Advice automation with the Vertex AI SDK to identify and auto-resolve eligible errors.
Built a Python/Flask developer-tools platform that unified scripts for data remediation, test-data generation, and production support.

Built distributed Java microservices with Spring Boot for claims adjudication and X12 EDI workflows, integrating Kafka and RabbitMQ for reliable event-driven processing; also delivered a React and GraphQL dashboard tracing claims across complex processing states.
Migrated standalone REST APIs from Play Framework to Kotlin and Spring Boot for a more maintainable microservice architecture.
Created Maven and Liquibase database modules, using jOOQ to generate reusable DAO classes and write native SQL across services.
Developed MongoDB APIs for dynamic properties and introduced TDD-oriented design documentation for new features.
Developed a Spring Boot base template for logging, authentication, and Artifactory configuration reused by 50+ microservices.
Integrated Kafka for real-time event synchronization and built asynchronous APIs for long-running provisioning workflows.
Built Neo4j graph models and a shortest-path API using Yen's K-Shortest path algorithm for network devices.
Resolved Fortify vulnerabilities and implemented transaction locking to prevent race conditions during device activation.
Integrated SAML single sign-on for internal and external identity providers.
Migrated on-premises lower environments to AWS EC2 and built scripts to create on-demand testing environments.
Built Spring Boot APIs and schedulers to query Apache Solr and refresh indexed data from Oracle, then migrated services from Apache Karaf.
